dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Today's debate topic is "Should university be free for everyone?" Nam, what's your point of view?
dialogue.reading: təˈdeɪz dɪˈbeɪt ˈtɑːpɪk ɪz ʃʊd ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti bi ˈfriː fər ˈɛvriwʌn? ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌts jʊr ˈpɔɪnt əv ˈvjuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: As far as I'm concerned, university should be free for everyone.
dialogue.reading: əz ˈfɑːr əz aɪm kənˈsɜːrnd, ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ʃʊd bi ˈfriː fər ˈɛvriwʌn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Because many smart students can't afford the tuition. In my opinion, that isn't fair.
dialogue.reading: bɪˈkɔːz ˈmɛni ˈsmɑːrt ˈstuːdənts ˈkænt əˈfɔːrd ðə tuˈɪʃən. ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən, ðæt ˈɪzənt ˈfɛr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Personally, I don't think it should be free for everyone.
dialogue.reading: ˈpɜːrsənəli, aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈθɪŋk ɪt ʃʊd bi ˈfriː fər ˈɛvriwʌn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Rich families can afford it. I'd say that only poor students should study for free.
dialogue.reading: ˈrɪtʃ ˈfæməliz kən əˈfɔːrd ɪt. aɪd ˈseɪ ðæt ˈoʊnli ˈpʊr ˈstuːdənts ʃʊd ˈstʌdi fər ˈfriː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Interesting. So you have different points of view.
dialogue.reading: ˈɪntrəstɪŋ. soʊ juː ˈhæv ˈdɪfərənt ˈpɔɪnts əv ˈvjuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, but we both want students from poor families to go to university.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, bʌt wiː ˈboʊθ ˈwɑːnt ˈstuːdənts frəm ˈpʊr ˈfæməliz tə ˈɡoʊ tə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good. That's a great start. Let's begin the debate!
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. ðæts ə ˈɡreɪt ˈstɑːrt. ˈlɛts bɪˈɡɪn ðə dɪˈbeɪt!
